SELECT id, name, capacity, day_rate, half_rate, description, is_active
FROM bookings.rooms
WHERE tenant_id = $1::integer
ORDER BY is_active DESC, name;

INSERT INTO bookings.rooms (name, capacity, day_rate, half_rate, description, tenant_id)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING
RETURNING *;

UPDATE bookings.rooms
SET name=$2, capacity=$3, day_rate=$4, half_rate=$5, description=$6, is_active=$7
WHERE id=$1
RETURNING *
  AND tenant_id = $8::integer;

UPDATE bookings.rooms SET is_active = FALSE WHERE id = $1
  AND tenant_id = $2::integer;
SELECT id, name, description, is_active FROM bookings.event_types WHERE tenant_id = $1::integer ORDER BY is_active DESC, name;

INSERT INTO bookings.event_types (name, description, tenant_id)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING
RETURNING *;

UPDATE bookings.event_types
SET name=$2, description=$3, is_active=$4
WHERE id=$1
RETURNING *
  AND tenant_id = $5::integer;

UPDATE bookings.event_types SET is_active = FALSE WHERE id = $1
  AND tenant_id = $2::integer;

SELECT rep.id, rep.room_id, rep.event_type_id,
       r.name AS room_name, et.name AS event_type_name,
       rep.day_rate
FROM bookings.room_event_pricing rep
JOIN bookings.rooms r ON r.id = rep.room_id
JOIN bookings.event_types et ON et.id = rep.event_type_id
WHERE rep.tenant_id = $1::integer
ORDER BY r.name, et.name;

INSERT INTO bookings.room_event_pricing (room_id, event_type_id, day_rate, tenant_id)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
ON CONFLICT (room_id, event_type_id)
DO UPDATE SET day_rate = EXCLUDED.day_rate
RETURNING *;
SELECT key, value, description, updated_at FROM bookings.settings ORDER BY key;
INSERT INTO bookings.settings (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING key, value, updated_at;

DELETE FROM bookings.room_event_pricing WHERE room_id = $1 AND event_type_id = $2
  AND tenant_id = $3::integer;
